cues: The first law says energy is conserved.
But it does not tell us which way a change will go.
Energy would be conserved just as well if heat flowed from a cold body into a hot one.
The second law supplies the direction.
text: The first law says energy is conserved. But it does not tell us which way a change will go. Energy would be conserved just as well if heat flowed from a cold body into a hot one. It never does. The second law supplies the direction.
